title: Discover RMIT's 2025 Scholarships

# Discover RMIT's 2025 Scholarships

## Overview

Over 25 years in Vietnam, RMIT University has awarded scholarships to more than 1,840 Vietnamese and international students, exceeding a total value of 566 billion VND. In 2025, the institution continues this commitment with scholarships totaling approximately 53.5 billion VND.

## 2025 Scholarship Types

RMIT Vietnam launched more than 106 scholarships for Vietnamese and international students in January 2025:

- 7 Vice-Chancellor's Scholars - covering 100% of tuition fees
- 22 Academic Achievement Scholarships - covering 25-50% of tuition fees
- Program-Specific Scholarships (covering 50% of tuition):
  - 11 scholarships from The Business School
  - 8 scholarships from School of Communication & Design
  - 5 scholarships from School of Science, Engineering & Technology

## Key Dates

- Applications open: 12 January 2025
- Applications close: 4 July 2025, 5:00pm GMT +7
- Results released: 26 September 2025

## Application Steps

1. Find your program
2. Check your eligibility
3. Prepare your documents
4. Submit your application

## Participating Programs

The Business School: Business, Tourism and Hospitality Management, Digital Marketing, Accounting

School of Science, Engineering & Technology: Information Technology, Engineering specializations, Psychology, Aviation, Food Technology and Nutrition

School of Communication & Design: Professional Communication, Digital Film and Video, Design Studies, Fashion, Games Design
